questions.question: What happens if you stay in neutral too long while shifting gears?

options.text: You may have trouble shifting into the next gear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may have trouble shifting into the next gear.
questions.explanation: Staying in neutral too long while shifting can make it hard to get into the next gear. If this happens, do not force the shift. Instead, go back to neutral, release the clutch, speed up the engine to match the road speed, and try again.

questions.question: How can a driver make their vehicle more visible in low light, such as at dawn or dusk?

options.text: Flash the lights on and off.

questions.explanation: When driving at dawn, dusk, or in bad weather, use your low-beam headlights to be more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a distracted person that drivers should worry about?

options.text: A driver talking to a passenger
A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus
A construction worker on the side of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus
questions.explanation: Watch out for people not paying attention to traffic. Drivers and pedestrians talking may be distracted. Workers near the road may not see traffic because they are focused on their work. A person sitting quietly on a bench is not a concern.

questions.question: Reaching unsafely for a phone while driving is:

options.text: Okay if you are driving alone.
Okay if you plan to use hands-free mode.
Never okay, even with hands-free mode.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never okay, even with hands-free mode.
questions.explanation: Your phone must be within easy reach while you are safely in your seat. Reaching unsafely for a phone while driving is dangerous and illegal, even if you plan to use hands-free features.

questions.question: Why should you check your tires regularly in hot weather?

options.text: Heat increases air pressure in the tires.
The tread wears faster in hot weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Heat increases air pressure in the tires.
questions.explanation: Air pressure increases when it is hot. Pay close attention to your tire pressure and condition when driving in hot weather.

questions.question: When making tight turns or maneuvers, you should:

options.text: Open your door to see better.

questions.explanation: Use your mirrors regularly while driving. Checking your mirrors is very important when driving in tight spaces.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, create space ahead of your vehicle so they can pass safely. Do not speed up, as they may tailgate you at the higher speed, making it more dangerous.

questions.question: How does a truck's weight affect stopping distance?

options.text: Weight has no effect on stopping distance.
Weight is a major factor in stopping distance.
The type of cargo matters more than weight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Weight is a major factor in stopping distance.
questions.explanation: A vehicle's weight greatly affects how long it takes to stop. Heavier vehicles need more braking force to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What should you use to put out an electrical fire?
questions.explanation: B:C fire extinguishers are made for electrical fires and burning liquids. Never use water on an electrical fire.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, which action is NOT recommended?

options.text: Try to move your vehicle to the side of the road.

questions.explanation: After an accident, protect the area, call for help, care for the injured, collect information, and report the accident. Leaving the scene of an accident can result in losing your license.

questions.question: If a speed limit is posted, can you exceed it?
questions.explanation: A posted speed limit is the maximum speed allowed. You must follow the speed limit under all conditions. You should drive slower if road or weather conditions require it. Never exceed the legal speed limit.

questions.question: When checking the exhaust system, how should it be?
questions.explanation: The exhaust system must be secure. All parts must be tight and in good condition. Nothing should be loose, broken, or missing.

questions.question: Where should a helper stand when you back up a vehicle?

options.text: In front of the passenger side
In front of the driver side
On the side of the truck
Near the back of the truck

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the back of the truck
questions.explanation: Your helper should stand near the back of the vehicle where you can see them. Before you back up, agree on hand signals with your helper. Make sure you both understand the signal for "stop."

questions.question: When should you adjust your mirrors?
questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors before you start driving. If you have a trailer, it must be straight for the mirrors to be adjusted correctly.

questions.question: Can gasoline be brought onto a bus?

options.text: Yes, it can be brought on.
Yes, if stored in the passenger area during long trips.
Yes, if stored in glass containers.

questions.explanation: Gasoline and other hazardous items like car batteries are not allowed on buses. This rule applies to both drivers and passengers.

questions.question: Is hanging meat as cargo stable or unstable?
questions.explanation: Hanging meat is unstable cargo. It swings around while the vehicle moves and has a high center of gravity.

questions.question: What can a trailer brake hand valve be used for?

options.text: Stop the vehicle from rolling backward when starting from a stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop the vehicle from rolling backward when starting from a stop.
questions.explanation: The trailer brake hand valve stops the vehicle from rolling backward when you start from a stop.

questions.question: After starting the engine, does coolant temperature decrease quickly?
questions.explanation: After starting the engine, coolant temperature should rise gradually to normal operating range. It should not decrease.

questions.question: What causes brake fade?
questions.explanation: Brake fade happens when brakes overheat from too much use. This makes the brakes less effective.

questions.question: When should a bus be refueled?

options.text: Inside a building with passengers on board.
Without passengers on board, unless absolutely necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Without passengers on board, unless absolutely necessary.
questions.explanation: Do not refuel a bus while passengers are on board unless it is absolutely necessary. Never refuel a bus with passengers inside an enclosed building.
